title: [review] tx_queue.rs:420: pop() returns expired ite
description: pop() does not call expire_before() or check is_expired(). If time advances between the last push() and a subsequent pop(), the returned item may have deadline_ms < now_ms (already expired). The caller must either call expire_before() before pop(), or check is_expired() on the returned item. This is likely intentional for performance but could surprise callers expecting only valid items.
notes: Implemented expiry-safe TxQueue observations in rust/lichen-core/src/tx_queue.rs. pop(), peek(now), count(now), is_empty(now), is_full(now), and has_allowed(now) prune expired entries first. Added monotonic time watermark so regressed timestamps cannot resurrect/admit stale items, explicit DeadlineExpired admission error, and u32 latency saturation. Deterministic tests cover all-expired, mixed priority/FIFO order, exact deadline boundary, clock regression, and bounded capacity reuse. Green: cargo test -p lichen-core (305 unit + integration/doc tests); cargo test -p lichen-core --test bufferbloat_vectors (5); cargo clippy -p lichen-core --lib -- -D warnings; cargo check -p lichen-core --no-default-features; rustfmt --check and git diff --check for tx_queue.rs. All-target clippy remains blocked only by pre-existing warnings in externally owned duty_cycle.rs/lib.rs/yggdrasil tests; not touched.
close_reason: Expiry-safe dequeue/observer semantics implemented and lichen-core gates green
